notes.title: GARBAGE COUNTRY officially revealed at the PC Gamer Showcase!
notes.content:
[p]Hi everybody![/p][p]
Thomas / noio here. Happy to say Garbage Country has now been officially revealed, with a new trailer in today’s PC Gamer Showcase. Check it out![/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="d4S9pdUVML8;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[/p][p]Those of you who’ve been following this page for a while will notice some major new additions. This is still an exploration game at its heart, but I’ve also added tower-defence mechanics. Players collect scrap to build turrets and use them to repel enemy bots![/p][p]
[/p][p]Thank you so much to everyone for your support so far. Please be sure to wishlist the game if you’re interested, and follow me on socials for regular updates! [/p][p]
[/p][p]All the best,[/p][p]Thomas[/p]
